revision.authority: CEO promotion decision 2026-07-25 (registry v1.6): bonferroni@v1 -> VALIDATED via the deterministic S7 acceptance suite. No stochastic calibration: Bonferroni is p*m; its FWER<=alpha guarantee is Boole's inequality (a theorem), not an empirical property.
revision.scope: Promote exactly one further method (bonferroni@v1) to VALIDATED via suite S7 (deterministic). Registry status stays PARTIALLY_EXECUTABLE, now 2 of 15. The registry assigns bonferroni only S7, disjoint from the stochastic suites S1/S3/S4 - no synthetic null, power curve or FPR is applied. matched_null@v1 remains VALIDATED. No other method changed. Data gaps (G6, OBS-0017) unaffected.
changes: Implemented bonferroni's declared output contract in ve/methods/bonferroni.py (pure function): threshold_per_test=alpha/m, p_adjusted=min(1,p*m), family_size, realized_family, dropped_members, m_realized; empty-eligible-family halts E6 PRECONDITION.
bonferroni@v1 gains a 'validation' object recording suite S7, deterministic, and the six verifications (tests/test_s7_bonferroni.py).
The remaining 13 methods stay UNVALIDATED and cannot be referenced by an official specification (rule unvalidated_not_executable).

rules.no_optional_parameters: Every parameter listed in required_params must be present in the specification. The registry declares no defaults; a default would be a choice made by the Validation Engine, which contract 1.7 forbids.
rules.closed_vocabulary: Any id not present in this registry halts the run with error E3. The engine never improvises a method, variable, predicate or statistic.
rules.explicit_no_correction: Absence of a multiple_testing section is not 'no correction'. No correction must be declared explicitly via none@v1.
rules.unvalidated_not_executable: A method whose calibration_status is not VALIDATED cannot be referenced by an official specification.
rules.two_stage_validation: Stage 1 validates shape against SPEC_SCHEMA_v1.0.json. Stage 2 validates vocabulary, required params and domains against this file. This file is the single source of truth for what is executable.
rules.p_value_estimator: Every resampling method reports k, B, p_hat=(k+1)/(B+1), Monte-Carlo CI and MC resolution. p=0 can never be produced.
rules.denominator_always_reported: The population builder always emits the number of candidate bars evaluated and the number rejected by each criterion.
rules.statistic_call_shape: A statistic is invoked as {id, statistic, params}: an inline declaration carrying its own parameters, identical in shape to a predicate. The engine never infers which variable a statistic applies to (registry v1.1, gap G2).
rules.raw_series_availability: For raw_series@v1, availability.offset_bars selects the bar whose field value is taken (offset 0 = the event bar). This differs from computed primitives such as atr@v1, where the offset means 'computed on data up to that bar'.
rules.predicate_list_conjunction: Every predicate list is a conjunction (logical AND) of its elements. population.include selects bars satisfying ALL include predicates; a bar is excluded if it matches ANY population.exclude predicate; cells[].predicates is the AND of its elements. Non-conjunctive logic must be written explicitly with and@v1 / or@v1 / not@v1.
rules.empty_predicate_lists: exclude: [] means 'no exclusion', declared explicitly, never assumed. A cell with predicates: [] means 'the whole population' (used by non-stratified tests). include must be non-empty (schema).
rules.per_criterion_denominator: Because every include predicate carries a unique id and the list is a conjunction, the population builder reports, per include criterion, how many candidate bars it rejected. This is the per-criterion denominator; predicate id uniqueness across the whole specification is what makes it unambiguous.
rules.indicator_availability: indicator@v1 turns a predicate into a 0/1 exposure variable. Its availability.offset_bars may not be earlier (more negative) than the availability of ANY variable used inside its predicate, checked recursively. More generally: no variable may declare an availability earlier than any of its dependencies.
rules.reference_types_resolved: Every parameter whose semantics is a reference (variable_ref, test_ref, predicate_ref, data_source_id, statistic_call) is resolved fail-closed at validation. An unresolved reference halts with E2 before any data access; it is never deferred to execution (gap G5).
rules.day_scope_boundary: The 'day' scope boundary is 00:00 UTC (Path A, CEO 2026-07-24), matching the in-sample scripts (df['dt'].dt.date). bar_position@v1 and first_in_scope@v1 with scope 'day' partition by UTC calendar date. A future local-anchored day (Statistician OPERATIONAL_DEFINITIONS direction) would require a separate, explicitly-versioned scope and a separate protocol.
rules.member_eligibility_whitelist: A member_eligibility rule may reference ONLY the fields in member_eligibility_fields (n, denominator, event_count) — all pre-outcome. Referencing p_hat/observed/effect/statistic is rejected at validation before any data access (gap G8, golden rule R3). Family membership therefore cannot syntactically depend on any result.
rules.member_eligibility_declared: The eligibility rule (e.g. n>=25) is declared in the specification and frozen in its hash; the engine applies it, never infers it. The validator checks structure and whitelist only; the realized family is computed at execution from data.
rules.empty_eligible_family_halts: If, at execution, no candidate member satisfies the eligibility rule, the run halts explicitly (E6 PRECONDITION) rather than silently correcting over an empty family.
rules.no_optional_eligibility: member_eligibility is required on bonferroni@v1 and benjamini_hochberg@v1. 'No filtering' is declared explicitly (a trivially-true rule), never by omission — like none@v1 for correction.

OANDA_XAUUSD_M15@v1.notes: No 'sub' column, unlike H1/H4/D1. Coverage starts ~2 weeks earlier than the other timeframes. Reported, not harmonised.

derivation: code/run_full_campaign.py:3 splits M15 84152 rows at 60/80 percent, holdout = 16831 bars starting exactly at this boundary (matches REPRODUCIBILITY_AUDIT.md).
DC-0004 cites 16,623 H1 bars 2023-01-02 to 2025-10-23, which is exactly the count of H1 bars before this same boundary.
sealed_registry.access_rule: Sealed rows are truncated in the loader before any computation module sees the data. Opening requires a valid CEO token, a completed rehearsal on the open window with an identical spec hash, and an unconsumed resource. Consumption is single-shot and irreversible.

availability_rules.outcome: offset_bars > 0 permitted; outcome window must be disjoint from the classification window
availability_rules.diagnostic: unconstrained, never usable as an input to a test
availability_rules.enforcement: Mechanical check of the declared rule. The guard does not infer intent; it verifies the declaration. Overlap between classification and outcome windows halts the run with E6.

raw_series@v1.note: Direct reference to a source field. The field must exist in the source's declared columns (M15 has no 'sub'); this is checked mechanically. availability.offset_bars selects the bar (0 = event bar), and the leakage guard applies exactly as to any other variable.

indicator@v1.note: Turns a declared predicate into a 0/1 exposure variable (1 where the predicate holds). Declared like any other variable, with availability and role. G3. Availability rule (indicator_availability): offset_bars may not be earlier than any variable used by the predicate, checked recursively; cycles among variable references are rejected (E2).

parkinson_volatility@v1.note: ln(H/L) log-range. Primary volatility metric of the lab.

session_label@v1.note: No predefined sessions exist in the engine. Boundaries are declared numerically by the specification.

first_in_scope@v1.note: True only on the FIRST bar within the scope where the inner predicate holds; lookahead-safe (uses only bars up to and including the current bar in the scope). Resolves G7. For scope 'day', the boundary is 00:00 UTC (Path A).

cooldown@v1.note: Mandatory in every population block. Declare 0 explicitly if no deduplication is wanted.

validation.evidence: F6 (uniformity/FPR/power/reproducibility) + F6.1 (session vol + heavy tails) + F6.2 (real drift) + F6.3 (AR1 reversion / multi-threshold FPR / arbitrary-level placebo), all at real-data conditions; plus the conditional-phi measurement on the real NY-up event population.
validation.validity_domain: forward K6 ONLY. The reversion breaking point was measured on the K6 curve. K12 is NOT covered: conditional phi at K12 = -0.058 (~3x the global -0.018) and the K12 breaking point was never measured. Any use at K12 or any other horizon requires separate validation.
validation.ny_up_cell: NY-up cell n approx 37-42, at the calibration boundary. KS p=0.003 on the distribution body (conservative direction). Tails nominal at 0.01 / 0.05 / 0.10.
validation.reversion_vulnerability: Confirmed vulnerability to mean-reversion at phi <= -0.10 (5.5x the real global -0.018). Conditional phi measured on the real event population: -0.018 at K6, with CI [-0.228, +0.212] which does NOT exclude the -0.10 threshold. The point estimate confirms the margin; precision cannot confirm it at n=42. This imprecision is a DC-0004-specific risk (reversion pattern), not a method risk.
validation.configuration: unstratified; stratified on SESSION; ATR-scaled. Volatility stratification does NOT exist and is NOT validated.

matched_null@v1.purpose: Structure-matched null: random timing with declared invariants preserved.
matched_null@v1.note: preserve is an explicit list of invariants. The engine never infers what must be preserved; a wrongly matched null is exactly how the existing implementation failed.

iid_bootstrap@v1.purpose: IID resampling. Diagnostic only; ignores autocorrelation.

permutation_test@v1.purpose: Label permutation under an explicitly declared exchangeability structure.

dip_test@v1.purpose: Hartigan unimodality test, for a proposed categorical separation.

gaussian_mixture@v1.purpose: Mixture model, for a proposed categorical separation.

changepoint@v1.purpose: Discontinuity detection in an ordered variable.

regression_control@v1.purpose: Regression of outcome on exposure with explicitly declared controls and interaction terms.

placebo_control@v1.purpose: Negative control: the same test applied to a declared placebo definition.

multiverse@v1.purpose: Sensitivity of the central test to alternative reasonable definitions.

power_simulation@v1.purpose: Power / minimum detectable effect by simulation.

descriptive_measurement@v1.purpose: Measurement without a test. Produces no p-value.

validation.rationale: Bonferroni is p*m; its FWER<=alpha guarantee is Boole's inequality (a theorem), not an empirical property. No null distribution, power, FPR or seed. Input p-value calibration is the upstream test method's responsibility (its S1/S3/S4), not the correction's. The registry assigns bonferroni only S7, disjoint from S1/S3/S4.
validation.evidence: tests/test_s7_bonferroni.py - six verifications: (1) arithmetic on known-answer fixtures; (2) realized-family accounting; (3) empty-eligible-family halt (E6); (4) outcome-independence R3 at the execution layer; (5) 'no filtering' declared explicitly; (6) determinism/idempotence.

none@v1.note: Must be declared explicitly. Absence of the multiple_testing section is an incomplete specification, not a declaration of no correction.

deliberately_absent: Any default threshold, window, horizon, seed or B
Profitability metrics (profit factor, Sharpe, drawdown, expectancy) as verdict statistics
